description: Keep server load, provider quotas, reset countdowns, and DeepSeek balance in view while you work in BB. Pin a draggable card with per-core CPU, disk busy time and IOPS, network speed, and CPU/RAM process leaders; detailed activity needs Linux. Quotas use BB's Provider usage plugin and configured accounts; the optional balance row needs local DSH with a DeepSeek API key and calls DeepSeek's balance API. Open charts and diagnostics, or enable background CPU and memory alerts.
